idea-plugin.name: Flutter Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Lists the @Preview widgets in the focused Dart file and renders them headlessly with flutter test, without a browser: single view with zoom, or a thumbnail grid. Re-renders on save, adds gutter icons on @Preview, follows the caret, and offers a "Create @Preview" intention.

Source, docs and issues: github.com/Jemshi101/FlutterPreview
